GitHub - jose-villegas/VolumeRendering: Volume Rendering with ...
Volume Rendering using Raycasting Made with C++, OpenGL, Cinder, GLM and dear imgui. Loads 8 and 16 bit raw volumetric data. And displays this volume on screen using raycasting. Some features include ray jitter with random noise and voxel's solidity check to reduce banding / artifacts, fast computation of gradients, gradients smoothing with 3x3x3 average filter and histogram extraction using ...
